verdict.rationale: Pika's first-party Language Swap app takes an uploaded speaking clip and produces translated speech with voice matching and lip sync, which is the core of this story. The evidence is limited to short vendor one-liners. Missing for 10: detail on supported languages and output quality for finished marketing videos, any limits on clip length, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can translate a finished video into other languages with the voice and lip sync carried over

citations.quote: Upload a speaking clip to create translated speech with voice matching and lip sync.
Language Swap: Same voice, new language
